description: This PHP script manages the 'platforms' view in the TestLink project, providing user interface logic and auxiliary functions for handling platform management, including initialization, rights checking, and template rendering.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class responsible for managing platform data and providing a GUI representation.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A templating class used for rendering HTML views.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns argument object containing current user, test project ID, and test plan ID, with validation.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to manage or view platforms.
